paper.title: How Do Prompt Variations Affect Energy Consumption in On-Device LLMs?
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed on mobile devices, making energy efficiency a key deployment constraint, yet the energy impact of prompt design remains underexplored. This paper aims to understand how two prompt properties, cognitive load and phrasing pattern, shape the energy behavior of on-device LLM inference. We conduct a broad empirical study covering prompt properties, datasets, models, and devices, with phase-level profiling that separates prefill and decode energy.

summary.core_problem: 移动端 LLM 推理的能耗受 prompt 写法影响，但这种影响在 prefill 和 decode 阶段如何体现尚缺少细粒度实证分析。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率实证研究。它不改模型结构或 serving 系统，但把 prompt 属性、token 使用量、每 token 能耗和质量-能耗边界联系起来，对端侧部署有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 围绕 cognitive load 和 phrasing pattern 两类 prompt 属性做实验，覆盖多个数据集、模型和设备；进行 phase-level profiling，把 prefill 与 decode 能耗分开统计，并分析能耗与输出质量之间的 frontier。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、设备数量和数值表。主要结论是 cognitive load 更影响每 token 能耗，phrasing pattern 主要通过改变 token usage 影响总能耗；不同模型的能耗-质量边界会因 prompt 设计而不同。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Georgia State University。

summary_en.core_problem: On-device LLM inference energy depends on prompt formulation, but the effects across prefill and decode phases are not well characterized.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an empirical study of inference efficiency. It does not introduce a new model architecture or serving system, but connects prompt properties, token usage, per-token energy, and energy-quality frontiers for mobile deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study varies two prompt properties, cognitive load and phrasing pattern, across datasets, models, and devices. It uses phase-level profiling to separate prefill and decode energy, then analyzes energy-quality trade-off frontiers.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the exact model list, device list, or numeric tables. The main findings are that cognitive load primarily affects energy per token, while phrasing pattern affects energy largely through token usage, and prompt design changes the attainable energy-quality frontier differently across models.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Georgia State University.

recommendation.zh: 端侧 serving 的经验事实，和 pretrain 关系远；只看 prefill/decode 能耗拆分，别把 prompt 结论外推太远。
recommendation.en: Useful as an on-device serving observation, distant from pretraining; only inspect the prefill/decode energy split and avoid overgeneralizing the prompt findings.

paper.title: Can your AI agent be cheaper? Investigating the effects of task specifications on token spend in agentic coding tasks
paper.abstract: Agentic coding workflows are now widely deployed in real-world systems. With long-horizon reasoning and tool use, token usage has become an important consideration for both cost and efficiency. Two engineers using AI will solve the same problem differently. How the specification of a task shapes an agent's token spend, and whether that spend can be predicted in advance, are open questions. Here, we study the effects of different task specifications on agentic token spend with the Kimi K3 model a

summary.core_problem: 研究 coding agent 的任务规格写法如何影响 token 消耗，以及能否在执行前预测成本分布。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 成本分析。它关注 long-horizon coding agent 的推理预算和 prompt 规格，而不是模型训练方法；对 serving 成本估算有参考价值，但对基座预训练启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 在 Kimi K3 上改变任务规格粒度和 thinking effort，统计 token spend。进一步用一个 cheap probe 为未知任务估计不同规格和 thinking effort 组合下的 token 消耗分布。
summary.experiments: 共 2700 次运行。把完整任务规格缩减为 bare user story 会使 token 消耗增加 29.7%；不同 prompt 不改变 run-to-run variance；任务间 prompt-sensitivity 差异很大，从 13% 到 115%。一个简单预测器可用单次便宜 probe 在未知任务上预测配置分布，误差在 36% 以内，并优于文中比较的先验方法。

summary_en.core_problem: Study how task specifications affect token spending in coding agents and whether the cost distribution can be predicted before full execution.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-cost analysis rather than a training-method paper. It is useful for reasoning about long-horizon coding-agent budgets and prompt specification, but it has limited direct impact on foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study varies task-specification detail and thinking effort using the Kimi K3 model, then measures token spend. It also fits a simple predictor that uses one cheap probe on an unseen task to estimate token-cost distributions across specification and effort settings.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports 2,700 runs. Reducing a full task specification to a bare user story increases token spend by 29.7%; prompt changes do not affect run-to-run variance; prompt sensitivity is task-dependent, ranging from 13% to 115%. A simple predictor estimates unseen-task configuration distributions within 36% error and improves over the referenced prior baseline.

recommendation.zh: 成本结论可做 agent serving 备忘；单模型 Kimi K3 的 setup 太窄，不宜外推到训练策略。
recommendation.en: Useful as an agent-serving cost note; the single-model Kimi K3 setup is too narrow to extrapolate to training decisions.

paper.title: TDD-Agent: Test-Driven Reasoning for Code Generation
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in code generation, yet ensuring correctness in complex, repository-level tasks remains challenging. Existing approaches often use generated tests as static post-hoc validators, which limits their ability to guide implementation and may introduce misleading feedback when the tests themselves are incomplete or incorrect. In this paper, we introduce TDD-Agent, which operationalizes the test-driven development paradigm for code generati

summary.core_problem: 在代码生成任务中，现有的基于测试的方法通常将生成的测试用作事后验证器（post-hoc validators），这限制了测试指导实现的能力，且当测试本身不完整或错误时，会引入误导性反馈。特别是在复杂的仓库级（repository-level）任务中，这种局限性更加明显。
summary.importance: 本文将测试驱动开发（TDD）范式引入 LLM 代码生成，提出 TDD-Agent。这不仅是一种新的 Agent 架构，更展示了“测试先行（test-first）”推理如何作为一种可执行的中间表示，帮助模型在编写代码前明确意图和边界条件，对提升复杂代码生成的正确性有重要启发。
summary.technical_approach: TDD-Agent 采用单智能体框架，包含两个阶段：1. 测试设计阶段：Agent 利用工具提取仓库上下文，理解目标函数需求，并生成初始单元测试套件。这一步强制模型在实现逻辑前消除需求歧义并定义行为边界。2. 迭代执行与细化阶段：Agent 基于初始测试生成代码，执行测试并获取反馈。如果测试失败，Agent 可以同时修改代码和测试（dual-track refinement），而不是像以往方法那样将测试视为不可变的约束。
summary.experiments: 在函数级基准（LiveCodeBench）和仓库级基准（RepoEval）上进行了评估。结果表明，TDD-Agent 显著优于基线方法。在 LiveCodeBench 上，轻量级的 TDD-prompt 变体证明了测试先行推理的有效性；在 RepoEval 上，TDD-Agent 框架展示了在需要仓库导航和依赖理解的复杂任务中的优势。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Methodology 部分关于 TDD-Agent 工作流的描述（特别是图 2），理解其如何实现代码和测试的双向迭代细化。此外，实验部分在 RepoEval 上的结果值得关注，这展示了该方法在复杂场景下的潜力。预计阅读时间 15-20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In code generation tasks, existing test-based approaches often use generated tests as static post-hoc validators, limiting their ability to guide implementation and potentially introducing misleading feedback when tests are flawed, especially in complex repository-level tasks.
summary_en.importance: This paper introduces TDD-Agent, operationalizing the Test-Driven Development (TDD) paradigm for LLM code generation. It highlights how "test-first" reasoning serves as an executable intermediate representation, helping models clarify intent and boundary conditions before coding, offering significant insights for improving correctness in complex code generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: TDD-Agent employs a single-agent framework with a two-phase workflow: 1. Test Design Phase: The agent uses tools to extract repository context, understand target function requirements, and generate an initial unit test suite, forcing the model to disambiguate requirements and define behavioral boundaries before implementation. 2. Iterative Execution and Refinement Phase: The agent generates code based on initial tests, executes them, and receives feedback. Crucially, if tests fail, the agent can refine both code and tests (dual-track refinement), unlike prior methods that treat tests as immutable constraints.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on function-level (LiveCodeBench) and repository-level (RepoEval) benchmarks. Results show TDD-Agent significantly outperforms baselines. On LiveCodeBench, a lightweight TDD-prompt variant isolates the effect of test-first reasoning; on RepoEval, the full framework demonstrates its advantage in complex tasks requiring repository navigation and dependency understanding.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methodology section detailing the TDD-Agent workflow (especially Figure 2) to understand the dual-track refinement of code and tests. The experimental results on RepoEval are also key to grasping the method's potential in complex scenarios. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做代码LLM后训练或Agent的可重点看§3的双轨迭代设计，纯基座预训练研究员仅需知道TDD先验能稳定提分。
recommendation.en: Researchers working on code LLM post-training or agents should focus on the dual-track refinement design in §3; pure pretrain researchers only need to note consistent gains from test-first priors.

paper.title: Mimicry without understanding: the origins of decision bias in large language models
paper.abstract: Large Language models (LLMs) were found to be susceptible to a host of social, affective, and cognitive biases. We examined two mechanisms through which such biases can be generated even when human preferences (in the training data) are not biased or when they are correctly categorized as being biased. The first is faulty mimicry of preferences based on human behavior: this involves LLMs inferring human preferences even when behaviors are logically unrelated to preferences. The second is mimicry

summary.core_problem: 在训练数据未必包含相同偏好的情况下，LLM 为什么仍会表现出社会/认知决策偏差（如从众、损失厌恶）。
summary.importance: 偏差来源的机制性假设：把偏差归因于“错误的偏好拟合/模仿”(mimicry) 而非简单的数据偏好分布；对对齐与数据标注如何描述“偏差”有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两类机制：1) 从与偏好逻辑无关的人类行为中错误推断偏好（faulty mimicry）；2) 直接模仿被明确标注为偏差的行为（mimicry of explicitly biased behaviors）。通过多组经济学式提示实验检验。
summary.experiments: 四个研究，测试 ChatGPT-4o 与 Qwen：在“行为不指示偏好”的描述下仍出现 social proof；在“损失厌恶被明确描述为偏差”的科学报告提示下仍复现该偏差，且报告中偏差强度可预测模型输出偏差强度。摘要未给出样本量与统计细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Why do LLMs exhibit decision biases (e.g., social proof, loss aversion) even when training data need not encode those preferences.
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic hypothesis: biases can arise from preference mimicry errors rather than merely biased preference distributions; relevant to how alignment/data descriptions can inadvertently induce biased behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two mechanisms: (1) faulty inference of preferences from behaviors logically unrelated to preferences; (2) mimicking explicitly biased behaviors even when labeled as biases. Tested via economics-style prompting studies.
summary_en.experiments: Four studies on ChatGPT-4o and Qwen: models show social-proof bias under non-indicative behavior reports; they also reproduce loss aversion when described as a bias, with report bias strength predicting model bias strength. Abstract lacks statistical details.

recommendation.zh: 结论更像“提示诱导偏差”的行为学复现，机制证据偏弱；但“偏差强度可被文本描述线性牵引”这点值得记在脑子里。
recommendation.en: More a behavioral replication of prompt-induced bias than a tight mechanism paper, but the ‘bias magnitude tracks textual descriptions’ result is worth keeping in mind.

paper.title: Your Prompt Is Not the Only Prompt: How Much Do LLMs Weight Structured-Output Schema Descriptions?
paper.abstract: Structured output, where an LLM populates a predefined JSON schema, has become a default mechanism for data labeling and information extraction, but it also introduces a second instruction channel through schema descriptions. We tested whether classification-label definitions are better placed in the system prompt, user prompt, or schema description using a single-field classification task with nonce labels across ten model configurations from two vendors. Schema descriptions did not consistentl

summary.core_problem: 研究结构化输出 JSON schema 中的 description 是否会作为第二条指令通道影响 LLM 行为。
summary.importance: 贡献是机制性测量而非新方法：它提醒 structured output 不是纯格式约束，schema description 会参与指令竞争。这对工具调用、数据标注、自动信息抽取和 post-train 指令层级设计有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造单字段分类任务，使用 nonce labels 避免模型依赖已有语义，比较标签定义放在 system prompt、user prompt 和 schema description 中的效果。进一步设置 prompt 与 schema 冲突的条件，测量 schema instruction 对最终分类的覆盖或干扰能力。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个模型供应商的十个模型配置。schema placement 没有稳定优于 prompt placement；在 GPT-4.1 和无 reasoning 的 GPT-5.4 上，相比 system prompt 低 11-13 个百分点。冲突设置下，错误 schema 指令导致准确率下降 5-45 点；Claude Haiku 4.5 从 52.5% 降到 7%，GPT-5.5 从 100% 降到 73%。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether JSON schema descriptions in structured-output APIs act as a second instruction channel for LLMs.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an empirical mechanism study rather than a new training method. It shows that structured-output schemas are not merely formatting metadata; they can compete with natural-language prompts, which matters for tool use, data labeling, information extraction, and post-training instruction hierarchy design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author uses a single-field classification task with nonce labels to avoid semantic shortcuts, and compares placing label definitions in the system prompt, user prompt, or schema description. The study then introduces conflicts between prompts and schemas to measure whether schema instructions can override or corrupt prompt instructions.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover ten model configurations from two vendors. Schema descriptions do not consistently outperform prompt-based placement; for GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.4 without reasoning, schema placement underperforms system prompts by 11-13 percentage points. Under prompt-schema conflicts, incorrect schema instructions reduce accuracy by 5-45 points; Claude Haiku 4.5 drops from 52.5% to 7%, and GPT-5.5 from 100% to 73%.

recommendation.zh: 只看 prompt/schema 冲突实验即可；它证明 schema 不是惰性元数据，但 setup 小，别外推到训练层级。
recommendation.en: Read only the prompt-schema conflict setup; it shows schemas are not inert metadata, but the setup is small and should not be overextended to training-level claims.

paper.title: Same physical state, different collective dynamics: state encodings select synchronization outcomes in language-model agents
paper.abstract: Language-model agents act on state encodings of their environment, yet these are treated as interchangeable interfaces. Using pretrained language models, we designed a circular-synchronization experiment applying a state-encoding intervention while holding the physical system fixed: each agent sees only a summary of its neighbours' relative phases and chooses to advance, stay or retard. Encoding that state as low-order circular moments rather than as a histogram selected different collective out

summary.core_problem: 在闭环多体交互系统中固定所有物理规则、任务目标、代理能力时，仅改变环境状态传递给LLM代理的文本编码格式，是否会彻底改变整个系统的集体涌现动力学结果。
summary.importance: 提供了直接实证：状态表示的格式本身就是强干预变量，与奖励、指令、环境规则无关，就能完全决定多LLM系统的收敛方向。这一观察对理解预训练模型习得的格式响应偏置如何在闭环交互中被放大为系统级行为、以及多代理系统的prompt设计有明确参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 设计了极简的环形耦合相位振荡器实验：17个无记忆、无目标、无历史信息的代理，每步仅接收邻居相位的编码文本，输出「前移/保持/后移」三个动作之一调整自身相位，所有物理更新规则完全固定。对比三种从同一份原始相位分布计算得到的编码：低阶环形矩（总结分布的均值方向和集中度）、按bin中心标注的24段直方图、按bin区间标注的24段直方图。实验匹配所有条件的初始随机种子，设置K=0零耦合严格对照排除物理引擎干扰，额外通过固定合成场的开环实验单独测量每种编码下的动作响应算子，剥离闭环反馈的混淆效应。
summary.experiments: 在GPT-5.4-mini上，正耦合条件下环形矩编码在6/6随机种子中实现完全同步（最终极序参量r1接近1），两种直方图编码均为0/6完全同步：中心标注直方图仅产生部分对齐，区间标注直方图常收敛到两簇反相对抗的稳态。K=0零耦合对照中三种编码的物理轨迹完全一致，排除了初始条件、引擎差异的混淆。开环响应测量显示：环形矩编码产生纯方向吸引的动作响应，区间编码产生无净方向的两瓣响应，中心编码甚至产生反向减速的净偏置。编码效应在Claude上可复现，但不同编码对应的效果方向发生反转。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注实验设计的控制变量逻辑（为什么要设置无记忆无目标的极简环境、K=0对照的作用）和图1、图2的结果对比，不需要深入钻研耦合振荡器的理论细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。核心可带走的结论是：预训练模型对不同文本表示的固有响应偏置，足以在闭环交互中塑造完全不同的宏观系统结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Tests whether purely textual differences in how environment state is encoded for LLM agents, with all physical rules, task objectives and agent capabilities held fixed, can shift the collective emergent dynamics of closed-loop multi-agent systems.
summary_en.importance: Provides concrete empirical evidence that state representation format acts as a strong intervention variable, fully determining convergent multi-agent outcomes independent of rewards, instructions, or environment physics. The observation informs understanding of how pre-trained representational biases toward text formatting scale up to system-level behavior in closed-loop interactions, with direct implications for multi-agent prompt design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Implements a minimal coupled circular phase oscillator setup with 17 stateless, goal-free agents with no access to history or identity. At each step, each agent receives only an encoded text summary of neighboring agents' relative phases, and outputs one of three actions (advance/stay/retard) to adjust its phase, with identical physical update rules across all conditions. Three encodings are tested, all computed from the same underlying phase distribution: low-order circular moments summarizing distribution direction and concentration, a 24-bin histogram labeled by bin centers, and an identical 24-bin histogram labeled by interval bounds. Initial random seeds are matched across conditions, a zero-coupling (K=0) control rules out engine confounds, and separate open-loop tests with fixed synthetic fields measure action response operators independent of closed-loop feedback effects.
summary_en.experiments: On GPT-5.4-mini, moment encoding achieved full synchronization (final polar order parameter r1 ~ 1) across 6/6 random seeds at positive coupling values, while both histogram encodings achieved 0/6 full synchronization. Center-labeled histograms produced only partial alignment, while interval-labeled histograms frequently converged to a stable two-cluster opposing state. The K=0 control produced identical physical trajectories across all encodings, eliminating initial condition and engine implementation confounds. Open-loop response measurements showed moment encoding produces pure directional attraction, interval encoding produces a two-lobed response with zero net directional bias, and center encoding produces a reversed net retarding bias. The qualitative encoding effect replicated on Claude, though the direction of effect across encodings was reversed.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for core design insights; focus on the control variable rationale (why the stateless, goal-free setup and K=0 control are required for valid causal attribution) and the result contrasts in Figures 1 and 2. No deep background in coupled oscillator theory is needed; estimated reading time 15 minutes. The core takeaway is that pre-trained models' inherent response biases to different text representations are strong enough to shape divergent macro-scale system outcomes in closed-loop interaction.

recommendation.zh: 实验设计干净，强提醒：状态序列化方式直接决定 agent 群体行为，做 agent/长链推理时别把 prompt 格式当无关变量；读 Fig2 和 replay 对照。
recommendation.en: A clean experiment showing state serialization is not a passive wrapper but an interaction term; read Fig. 2 and the replay control before designing agent interfaces.

paper.title: Soft Guidance Starts to Outperform CoT Prompting as LLMs Improve
paper.abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting remains the standard baseline for evaluating models' reasoning abilities. Originally, this technique was introduced to elicit step-by-step reasoning from large language models (LLMs), which would otherwise tend to directly output the final answer. However, many modern LLMs produce CoT-style responses \textit{natively} when presented with reasoning tasks, which made us revisit the effectiveness of standard CoT prompting.   We evaluate several modern mid-sized lang

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文重新检查一个评测假设：对已经经过推理训练的现代 LLM，few-shot CoT 示例是否仍然是合理的推理能力基线。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练研究的启发主要在评测接口上。早期 CoT prompt 的作用是把模型从“直接给答案”的输出模式拉到“分步推理”的模式；但推理专门模型在预训练后期、SFT 或 RL 阶段已经见过大量推理轨迹，CoT 风格不再稀缺。此时，人工 few-shot 示例可能不再提供有效计算路径，反而引入风格匹配、格式约束和示例分布偏差。这个结论会影响 reasoning model 的能力报告方式，也会影响新推理方法的增益估计：如果 baseline 被 few-shot CoT 压低，后续方法的提升会被高估。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接，但问题选得准。作者比较了几类提示方式：标准 few-shot CoT，包括人工编写、随机选择的分步示例；zero-shot free-form generation，即不给额外 CoT 指令，让模型按自身习惯回答；zero-shot CoT，即加入类似“Let’s think step by step”的软提示；以及更强的、由模型生成示例的 CoT 变体，用来减少人工示例风格不匹配的问题。核心观察是，few-shot CoT 对新模型不只是“多给信息”，也会改变生成分布。模型需要同时完成数学推理、模仿示例格式、适配示例中的表达风格，这些附加约束会占用上下文和解码自由度。对已经内化推理格式的模型，收益变小，干扰变大。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在现代中等规模语言模型的数学解题任务上，包含 Mathstral-7B、Qwen 系列和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 等模型。关键数字是：Mathstral 的官方 few-shot CoT 报告约为 77.1%，作者复现的人工 few-shot CoT 最好不超过 74.2%；改用 zero-shot free-form 后达到 83.8%，加入 zero-shot CoT 软提示后进一步到 86.1%。Qwen 上也观察到类似现象，few-shot CoT 最好不超过 83.4%，zero-shot 设置达到 88.6%。论文还给出定性样例，说明模型在复杂文字题中可能已经自然产生分步推理，而额外示例并不一定帮助纠错。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 few-shot CoT 失效机制的分析，以及实验表中 zero-shot、zero-shot CoT、few-shot CoT 的直接对比。值得关注的不是 prompt 技巧本身，而是评测协议随模型训练分布变化而失效的现象。做 reasoning eval、SFT/RL 数据构造或报告模型能力时，应检查 few-shot 示例是否在压制模型的原生输出策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether few-shot Chain-of-Thought prompting is still a valid reasoning baseline for modern LLMs that have already been trained to produce reasoning traces.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in evaluation design for reasoning models. CoT prompting originally helped models switch from direct-answer behavior to step-by-step reasoning. For reasoning-specialized models, that behavior is often already learned during late pretraining, instruction tuning, or RL. In this regime, human-written few-shot CoT examples can become an extra constraint rather than useful guidance. They may force style imitation, formatting compliance, and example-specific conventions. This matters because a weak baseline can underestimate model capability and inflate the apparent gains of new reasoning methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares standard few-shot CoT with simpler zero-shot settings. The evaluated variants include human-crafted few-shot CoT examples, free-form zero-shot generation, zero-shot CoT with a light instruction such as “Let’s think step by step,” and stronger CoT variants using model-generated examples. The key technical point is distributional: few-shot CoT does not only add information. It also changes the target generation style. A model must solve the problem while adapting to the demonstrations’ format and reasoning style. For models that already produce reasoning traces natively, this added constraint can hurt more than it helps.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on math problem solving with modern mid-sized models, including Mathstral-7B, Qwen models, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The central numbers are clear. For Mathstral, the best reproduced human few-shot CoT result is at most 74.2%, while the official report gives about 77.1%. Free-form zero-shot generation reaches 83.8%, and zero-shot CoT reaches 86.1%. For Qwen, the best few-shot CoT result is at most 83.4%, while the zero-shot setting reaches 88.6%. The qualitative examples support the same point: some models already generate multi-step solutions without demonstrations, and extra examples can introduce avoidable distractions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s diagnosis of why few-shot CoT can fail, then inspect the tables comparing free-form zero-shot, zero-shot CoT, and few-shot CoT. The useful lesson is not a new prompting trick. It is that evaluation protocols can become stale as the model’s training distribution changes. This is relevant when reporting reasoning capability, constructing SFT/RL data, or comparing new inference-time reasoning methods.

recommendation.zh: 会改变 reasoning eval 的默认 prompt prior；先看实验表和 guidance-distraction 解释，内部评测应立刻复测。
recommendation.en: This should change the default prompt prior for reasoning evals; read the result tables and guidance-distraction argument, then rerun internal eval prompts.

paper.title: Would You Walk to the Car Wash? Revealing the Salience Bias of Large Language Models in Commonsense Reasoning
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance in complex reasoning tasks, they have learned to heavily prioritize explicit conditions provided in the input. However, in everyday commonsense reasoning, this mechanism exposes a critical vulnerability which we term Salience Bias: models become easily hijacked by useless explicit distractors (e.g., numerical values), leading them to ignore the implicit physical or commonsense prerequisites of a task. A critical open question is whether this fa

summary.core_problem: LLM 在常识推理里会被输入中“显眼但无用”的显式条件（尤其是数字/计算线索）劫持，导致忽略隐含的物理/常识前提；论文要回答的关键是：这到底是常识知识缺失，还是在误导性 framing 下被抑制（knowledge suppression）。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新训练法，而在于把一个“训练信号偏置→推理时注意力分配偏置→知识被压住”的失效链条拆开，并给出可操作的诊断坐标：把失败分成 trap detection 与 trap avoidance 两个轴；再用 re-elicitation 证明很多失败不是能力缺口而是提取失败。这对数据配比与后训练（偏数学/规划/计算式指令）如何改变模型的输入显著性偏好，有明确启发：需要在训练信号里显式惩罚对无关条件的过拟合，或加入“反显著性”的课程/对比数据。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是构建 SaliTrap：把“物理上不可能/违反常识前提”的 trap core 伪装进看似合理的规划/优化式自然语言问题里，并注入一组数值 distractors 诱导模型走计算路径。数据设计强调三条 well-formedness：trap 必须确实不可能；正确回答必须触及不可能性、不能通过回答子问题逃逸（sub-task escape）；数值 distractors 让问题外观与正常任务难以区分。trap 维度分四类：缺失前置条件（如洗车必须有车）、环境不匹配、时间/生理约束违背、规则不匹配。评测上区分：是否识别到 trap（detection）与是否在最终建议/结论里拒绝 trap（avoidance），并分析 distractor 密度对两者的影响。最后用“去 framing 的再提取”（把误导性计算外壳剥离）来验证知识是否存在，从而把问题归因到 suppression/elicitation bottleneck，而不是知识缺失。
summary.experiments: 基准规模 1,145 条，覆盖四类 trap；评测 12 个主流模型。文中给出几个关键现象：最强模型在原始设定下也只有 54.8% 的 trap avoidance，12 个里有 8 个低于 30%；数值 distractor 越多，avoidance 下降且 CoT 被劫持（CoT-Hijacked）上升；即便模型显式“识别到陷阱”，仍可能高比例顺从错误 framing（例：GLM-5.1 与 Kimi-K2 在识别后仍分别有 86.2% 与 81.8% 的顺从/合规行为，体现 detection≠avoidance）；通过剥离误导 framing 的 re-elicitation，多个代表模型的平均 Liberation Rate 从 Cond-A 提升到 Cond-C，支持“知识在但被压住”的结论。论文还报告模型表现与总体推理能力相关，并呈现随 distractor 密度与模型来源（provenance）聚类的结构性差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：优先看 Figure 1/2（现象与任务形式）、SaliTrap 的 well-formedness 三条件与 sub-task escape 定义（决定了基准是否“干净”）、以及 detection vs avoidance 的分解与对应统计。再看 re-elicitation/Cond-A→Cond-C 的实验段落：这是把“能力缺失”与“提取失败”区分开的关键证据。预计 30–45 分钟可抓住主要结论；若要用于训练改进，建议额外细读 distractor 密度控制与判定标准（judge/validation pipeline）以便复现或扩展数据合成。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode in commonsense reasoning where LLMs over-weight explicit, salient but irrelevant conditions (especially numbers and computation cues), and consequently ignore implicit physical/commonsense prerequisites. The central question is whether this reflects missing commonsense knowledge or knowledge suppression caused by misleading task framing.
summary_en.importance: Its value to pretraining/post-training research is diagnostic rather than algorithmic: it decomposes the failure into (i) trap detection and (ii) trap avoidance, and then shows via re-elicitation that many errors are not competence gaps but retrieval/elicitation failures. This points to a training-signal issue: modern mixtures and RL/SFT rewards often over-reinforce “use every given condition” behavior (common in math/planning/coding prompts) without penalizing attention to irrelevant details, which can systematically bias salience handling at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach: They build SaliTrap, a benchmark of computation-laden natural language queries that embed a physically impossible premise (the trap core) while injecting numerical distractors to induce spurious calculation. Items are constrained to be well-formed: the trap must be genuinely impossible under common knowledge; any correct answer must acknowledge the impossibility (preventing sub-task escape); and distractors must make the prompt look like a legitimate planning/optimization query. Traps span four dimensions (missing prerequisite, environmental mismatch, temporal/physiological violation, rule mismatch). Evaluation explicitly separates detection from avoidance, analyzes distractor-density effects, and uses de-framed re-elicitation (removing the misleading computational wrapper) to test whether the underlying knowledge is present but suppressed.
summary_en.experiments: SaliTrap contains 1,145 items across four trap types; 12 frontier LLMs are evaluated. Reported headline numbers: the best model avoids traps only 54.8% of the time under the original framing, and 8/12 models fall below 30%. Increasing the number of numerical distractors monotonically reduces avoidance and increases “CoT-hijacked” behavior. Detection does not imply avoidance: even after explicitly recognizing the trap, GLM-5.1 and Kimi-K2 still comply 86.2% and 81.8% of the time, respectively. Re-elicitation with stripped framing substantially increases “liberation” (Cond-A to Cond-C), supporting the knowledge-suppression interpretation. The paper also notes performance correlates with general reasoning strength and clusters by model provenance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim path: start with Figures 1–2 for the phenomenon and task structure; then read the benchmark well-formedness criteria (especially the sub-task escape constraint) and the detection-vs-avoidance protocol. Finally, focus on the re-elicitation/Cond-A→Cond-C section, since it is the key evidence separating missing knowledge from suppressed knowledge. 30–45 minutes is enough for the main takeaways; spend extra time on the validation/judging pipeline if you plan to reuse the dataset for training or analysis.

recommendation.zh: 把“显式条件优先”做成可复现的陷阱评测，能直接当训练回归集；只看数据构造和“识别≠规避”的分析结论即可。
recommendation.en: Turns the ‘explicit-condition-first’ failure into a reproducible trap benchmark you can use as a training regression set; focus on dataset design and the detection≠avoidance finding.

paper.title: The Maskability Index: Predicting Task-Objective Alignment in Pretrained Language Models
paper.abstract: Large-scale pretrained language models such as T5 and BERT have demonstrated strong capabilities for generating structured knowledge. However, their performance depends on how closely the prompting strategy matches the objectives used during pretraining. We introduce the Maskability Index (MI), a quantitative metric that estimates whether a knowledge relation is better suited to masked-style prompting or prefix-style prompting in few-shot generation. MI is computed from differences in DepthRank

summary.core_problem: 预测某个知识关系更适合 masked-style prompting 还是 prefix-style prompting，减少提示形式与预训练目标不匹配带来的性能损失。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和轻量指标。它把“预训练目标与下游提示模板是否对齐”量化为 Maskability Index，对理解 BERT/T5 一类模型的知识抽取行为有一定参考，但实验规模和外推到现代 decoder-only LLM 的价值有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Maskability Index，即根据 masked 与 unmasked 模板之间的 DepthRank 分数差异，估计某类关系对 mask-style 目标的适配程度。方法不是新训练范式，而是一个用于模板选择和少样本适配的诊断指标。
summary.experiments: 在 ATOMIC2020 knowledge base completion 的多类关系上评估 MI，使用 T5、BERT 等预训练语言模型，报告 MI 与下游生成表现正相关。摘要未给出参数规模、训练数据或具体相关系数。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Sirjan University of Technology；未看到与大型预训练团队相关的背景信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper predicts whether a knowledge relation is better served by masked-style or prefix-style prompting, aiming to reduce mismatch between prompts and pretraining objectives.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/diagnostic contribution. It quantifies objective-template alignment through a Maskability Index, which is relevant to understanding BERT/T5-style knowledge extraction, though the evidence is small-scale and less directly applicable to modern decoder-only LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Maskability Index is computed from differences in DepthRank scores between masked and unmasked templates. It acts as a diagnostic for choosing prompting templates and adaptation strategies rather than as a new training objective.
summary_en.experiments: The metric is evaluated on relation types from ATOMIC2020 knowledge base completion with pretrained models such as T5 and BERT. The paper reports a positive correlation between MI and downstream generation performance; the abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, or exact coefficients.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Sirjan University of Technology; no major foundation-model training group background is evident from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 只看 MI 定义和相关性实验即可；它提醒目标-模板对齐仍重要，但离现代预训练 recipe 还远。
recommendation.en: Read only the MI definition and correlation study; it is a useful reminder about objective-template alignment, not a modern pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Prompt Design at Scale: How Format, Instruction Count, and Context Length Shape Instruction Adherence and Hallucination in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Practitioners make three prompt-design decisions with almost no controlled evidence behind them: how to format instructions and context (markdown, plain text, prose, or tabular), how many simultaneous instructions a system prompt can carry before compliance degrades, and how much context a model can hold before recall and honesty degrade. We report two controlled experiments crossing all three factors on one held, contamination-free synthetic corpus (the "Book of Veyra," 8,780 uniquely-named ent

summary.core_problem: 用受控实验回答三个提示设计问题：格式、同时指令数量、上下文长度如何影响指令遵循、召回和幻觉。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测协议和受控实验，而不是新模型方法。它用可确定再生成的合成语料“Book of Veyra”降低污染风险，给 prompt engineering 中常见但缺少实证的规则提供测量依据。
summary.technical_approach: 实验交叉控制三类因素：markdown、纯文本、散文、表格等格式；系统提示和用户轮次位置；规则数量从 10 增长到 160。语料包含 8,780 个唯一命名实体，并可由固定随机种子复现，用于测量指令遵循衰减、长上下文召回和诚实性变化。
summary.experiments: Experiment 1 对每个模型进行 960 次调用，覆盖五个模型。摘要给出的关键结果是：当规则数量达到 N=80 时，所有模型、格式和放置方式的完美回答率都降为 0；在 N=160 时，提示放置位置的影响常常不小于格式影响，且方向依模型而变；没有模型显示稳定的 markdown 优势。摘要未完整给出第二个实验的数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how prompt format, number of simultaneous instructions, and context length affect instruction adherence, recall, and hallucination.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation protocol and controlled evidence rather than a new modeling method. The deterministically regenerable synthetic corpus, Book of Veyra, is designed to reduce contamination and test prompt-design folklore under controlled conditions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The experiments cross prompt format, including markdown, plain text, prose, and tables; prompt placement in the system versus user turn; and instruction count from 10 to 160. The corpus contains 8,780 uniquely named entities generated from a fixed seed, enabling controlled tests of adherence decay, recall, and honesty under longer contexts.
summary_en.experiments: Experiment 1 runs 960 calls per model across five models. The abstract reports that perfect-response rate collapses to zero by N=80 for every model, format, and placement; at N=160, placement effects are often at least as large as format effects and are model-specific; no model shows a reliable markdown advantage. The supplied abstract does not fully report the second experiment's numbers.

recommendation.zh: 不必通读；记住 N=80 全线崩和 markdown 无稳定收益，内部 prompt eval 可直接复刻这个 setup。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; keep the N=80 collapse and lack of markdown gain, and reuse the setup for internal prompt evals.

paper.title: Simplicity Paradox: Debunking myths about prompting and datasets for LLM evaluation
paper.abstract: Probing the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) and building robust solutions for Multiple-Choice Question Answering (MCQA) remain central challenges in natural language understanding. Furthermore, the rapid proliferation of LLMs has created the implicit assumption that more sophisticated prompting techniques yield better performance. Several studies claim better performance with more sophisticated prompting techniques, but do not provide a comprehensive evaluation. We address this gap

summary.core_problem: 检验 MCQA 评测中一个常见假设：更复杂的 prompting 是否真的系统性优于简单 baseline prompting。
summary.importance: 这是评测与分析类工作。价值不在提出新模型，而在于用较大规模对比实验提醒大家：prompting 复杂度和评测结论之间常有混淆，尤其在多选题这类格式化任务上。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统比较 8 种 prompting 技术，在 10 个 MCQA 数据集、27 个模型配置上做大规模重复评测，重点分析 baseline prompting、复杂 reasoning prompting、以及少量 role framing 变体之间的差异，并关注统计显著性而非单点最好结果。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的规模是约 4300 个独特问题、43 万次以上评测。主要结论是：baseline prompting 在多个 benchmark 上持续优于复杂 reasoning 技术；只有 CoT-Expert 和 CoT-Inductive 带来小幅但统计显著的提升。由于任务局限在 MCQA，这个结论更适合作为 eval hygiene 信号，而不是对开放式推理的普遍定律。

summary_en.core_problem: It tests a common assumption in MCQA evaluation: whether more sophisticated prompting consistently outperforms simple baseline prompting.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation/analysis paper. Its value is not a new model, but a fairly broad empirical reminder that prompt complexity can confound evaluation conclusions, especially on structured tasks like multiple-choice QA.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare 8 prompting techniques across 10 MCQA datasets and 27 model configurations, focusing on baseline prompting, more complex reasoning prompts, and a few role-framing variants, with attention to statistical significance rather than cherry-picked best cases.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports roughly 4,300 unique questions evaluated more than 430,000 times. The main finding is that baseline prompting consistently beats complex reasoning techniques on many benchmarks, with only CoT-Expert and CoT-Inductive showing small but statistically significant gains. Because the scope is MCQA, this should be read as an eval-hygiene result rather than a universal law of reasoning prompts.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改变模型方法，但会提醒你别把 prompt 花活当能力提升；只看实验设置和主结论，尤其适合清理 MCQA eval pipeline。
recommendation.en: It will not change your modeling stack, but it is a good reminder not to mistake prompt theatrics for capability gains; read the setup and headline result, especially for MCQA eval hygiene.

paper.title: Deep Interaction: An Efficient Human-AI Interaction Method for Large Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: The emergence of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly enhanced the ability of large language models (LLMs) to tackle complex, multi-step tasks. However, when errors occur, current interaction approaches typically involve re-generating another response that may make mistakes again, or users laboriously flag the faulty step in follow-up turns that may get responses <You are right, I made a mistake here> followed by similar errors recurring. To address this issue, we propose an effici

summary.core_problem: 解决大推理模型在 CoT 中间步骤出错后，用户很难精确纠错且重新生成容易重复犯错的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是人机交互和推理纠错流程改进，不是预训练方法。它对研究员的间接价值在于观察外部人类编辑信号如何约束推理轨迹，可作为后训练数据采集或交互式 verifier 设计的弱参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Deep Interaction：允许用户直接编辑原回答中的错误推理片段，保留正确步骤；随后将编辑后的 CoT 提炼成 distilled prompt，用该 prompt 引导模型沿修正后的推理路径继续生成。方法更像交互式 prompting 与轨迹修补，而非模型参数更新。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 correction success rate 提升超过 25%，token usage 降低约一半。未从摘要中看到模型规模、具体任务集、baseline 细节或错误类型分层，因此结论需要看实验设置是否干净。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets error correction in CoT reasoning, where users currently either regenerate full answers or point out faulty steps in follow-up turns, often leading to repeated mistakes.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an interaction protocol for reasoning correction rather than a pretraining method. Its indirect value is in showing how human edits can constrain reasoning trajectories, which may inform post-training data collection or verifier-assisted interaction design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Deep Interaction lets users directly edit erroneous spans in the original response while preserving correct reasoning steps. The edited CoT is then refined into a distilled prompt that steers the model along the corrected reasoning path. This is closer to interactive prompting and trajectory repair than parameter training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports more than a 25% improvement in correction success rate and roughly reduced token usage. Model sizes, task suites, baseline details, and error-type breakdowns are not visible from the abstract, so the strength of the result depends heavily on the setup.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和实验设置；若编辑轨迹能稳定复用，才值得转化为后训练数据采集方案。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and setup only; it becomes useful if edited trajectories reliably transfer into post-training data collection.

paper.title: Which Algorithm Specification Formats Help Language Models Implement Machine Learning Algorithms?
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to implement algorithms from research manuscripts, but papers often leave implementation choices implicit. This study examines how the written format of an algorithm specification affects first-pass LLM implementation accuracy. We compare ordinary prose, LaTeX algorithm-style pseudocode, PDF-like extracted pseudocode, Markdown fields, YAML-like specifications, JSON-like specifications, and Python code stubs across five machine learning tasks, th

summary.core_problem: 研究算法说明的书写格式如何影响 LLM 首次实现机器学习算法的正确率。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding LLM 的经验评估。它关注 prompt/specification format 对实现细节的影响，对用 LLM 从论文复现实验、自动生成参考实现和构造代码评测数据有一定参考价值，但不直接推进预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 比较普通 prose、LaTeX algorithm-style pseudocode、PDF-like extracted pseudocode、Markdown fields、YAML-like specification、JSON-like specification 和 Python code stub。实验覆盖 5 个机器学习任务、3 个模型、4 种信息设置，用 hidden tests 检查 tie-breaking、array shape、数值规则、返回结构和非法输入行为等细节。
summary.experiments: 共生成 4,020 份实现。摘要称在 core-information 设置下，LaTeX algorithm-style pseudocode 的平均格式效果最大，YAML-like specification 和普通 prose 接近；在 complete-information 设置下，GPT-5.4 mini 不再显示明显格式差异。未给出完整模型列表和具体正确率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how the written format of an algorithm specification affects an LLM's first-pass accuracy when implementing machine learning algorithms.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical coding-LLM evaluation. It is useful for paper-to-code workflows, implementation-oriented prompting, and code evaluation design, but it does not directly affect foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study compares ordinary prose, LaTeX algorithm-style pseudocode, PDF-like extracted pseudocode, Markdown fields, YAML-like specifications, JSON-like specifications, and Python code stubs. It spans five machine-learning tasks, three models, and four information settings, using hidden tests for tie-breaking, shapes, numerical rules, return formats, and invalid inputs.
summary_en.experiments: The authors generate 4,020 implementations. Under the core-information setting, LaTeX algorithm-style pseudocode has the largest average format effect, with YAML-like specifications and prose close behind. Under complete information, GPT-5.4 mini shows no format differences. The abstract does not provide the full model list or exact accuracy numbers.

recommendation.zh: 看实验设计和 hidden tests 就够；它提醒代码数据合成别迷信 JSON，信息完整性可能比格式更要紧。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and hidden tests only; it is a useful warning that code-data synthesis should not over-trust JSON when information completeness dominates format.

paper.title: Prompt Framing Distorts Count-Based Evaluation of LLM Error Detection: Evidence from Numeric Anchoring
paper.abstract: Count-based F1 is widely used as a proxy for LLM error-detection quality, but this paper shows that it can rise dramatically without a corresponding improvement in span localization, a gap termed F1 Inflation. The paper introduces ErrorBench, a controlled stress-test protocol for prompt-induced count distortion. ErrorBench evaluates six contemporary LLMs under five prompt conditions over 4,290 responses from 143 CoNLL-2014 passages. Under CoNLL-2014 M2-style scoring, anchored prompts produce up

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究一个评测失真问题：用 count-based F1 评估 LLM 的错误检测能力时，提示词里的数字锚定会显著抬高分数，但并不对应更好的错误定位能力。
summary.importance: 价值主要在评测方法而不是模型方法。它指出了一个容易被忽略的 protocol 漏洞：当任务要求模型“报出错误个数”或受数字暗示时，Count-F1 可能被系统性抬高，导致不同模型、不同 prompt、甚至不同产品线之间的比较失真。这对做 verifier、judge、error detection、以及任何 count-sensitive evaluation 的研究都算一个干净的负面结果。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ErrorBench 作为受控 stress-test protocol，专门测量 prompt-induced count distortion。核心做法是在同一批样本上构造多种 prompt 条件，比较 Blind 与 Anchored 等设置下 Count-F1、strict matching、以及 ERRANT 多参考 F0.5 的变化，从而把“计数响应变大”与“span localization 真变好”拆开。技术上不是新模型，而是更干净的评测设计与复现实验。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 6 个当代 LLM、143 个 CoNLL-2014 passage、共 4,290 个响应。在 CoNLL-2014 M2-style scoring 下，anchored prompts 最多带来 0.79 的 F1 Inflation；strict matching 下最高到 0.96。作者还用 100-passage 子集和官方 ERRANT 3.0.0 + multi-reference scoring 做复现：6 个模型平均从 Blind 到 Anchored，Count-F1 提升 +0.21，但多参考 ERRANT F0.5 只提升 +0.04。GPT/Claude 一类高指令服从模型在该 stress test 下更容易出现较大的 count response，Gemini 家族较弱。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学。单作者工作，定位更像评测协议校准与负结果分析，不是基座模型训练论文。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper studies an evaluation artifact: count-based F1 for LLM error detection can be substantially inflated by numeric prompt anchoring without any corresponding gain in span localization quality.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in evaluation methodology rather than modeling. It exposes a protocol-level failure mode: when prompts contain numeric anchors or implicitly ask for counts, Count-F1 can rise systematically and distort comparisons across prompts, models, and product families. This is a useful cautionary result for verifier, judge, error-detection, and other count-sensitive evaluation setups.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces ErrorBench, a controlled stress-test protocol for prompt-induced count distortion. The key idea is to evaluate the same samples under multiple prompt conditions, comparing Blind vs. Anchored settings across Count-F1, strict matching, and multi-reference ERRANT F0.5, so that larger count outputs can be separated from genuine improvements in span localization. This is not a new model, but a cleaner evaluation design with replication.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover 6 contemporary LLMs, 143 CoNLL-2014 passages, and 4,290 responses. Under CoNLL-2014 M2-style scoring, anchored prompts induce up to 0.79 F1 inflation; under strict matching, up to 0.96. A 100-passage replication with the official ERRANT 3.0.0 pipeline and multi-reference scoring reproduces the pattern: averaged over six models, Blind-to-Anchored raises Count-F1 by +0.21 but multi-reference ERRANT F0.5 by only +0.04. GPT/Claude-style highly instruction-compliant systems show larger count responses, while Gemini-family models show smaller ones in this stress test.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from Zhejiang University. This is best read as an evaluation-calibration and negative-results paper rather than a foundation-model training paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它提醒你别把 count-style 自动评测当真；看 abstract 和复现实验数字就够，适合给内部 eval protocol 排雷。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it is a good reminder that count-style automatic metrics can be gamed by prompt framing; abstract plus the replication numbers are enough to sanity-check your eval stack.

paper.title: Technical Report of RoboSpatial Challenge at CVPR 2026: Selective Reasoning Activation and Reference-Frame Disambiguation for Embodied Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Vision-language models achieve strong general perception but often struggle with the spatial reasoning required for embodied tasks. We present RoboSpatialBrain, our submission to the RoboSpatial Challenge at the Embodied Reasoning in Action Workshop, CVPR 2026, built on RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV. RoboSpatialBrain combines two training-free, inference-time mechanisms: a forced <think> prefix activation strategy paired with a task-specific post-prompt that elicits deliberate reasoning on context and comp

summary.core_problem: 解决VLM在具身空间推理中对参考系歧义和是否触发显式推理链把握不稳的问题。
summary.importance: 这是挑战赛技术报告，不是新的预训练方法。价值主要在于两个推理时技巧：选择性激活思维链，以及显式参考系重定向。对做多模态推理和具身VLM的人有一点实操参考，但对基座预训练启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV，提出两项 training-free 推理机制：一是强制加入 <think> 前缀并配合任务特定后提示，促使模型在上下文与兼容性任务上进行显式推理；二是参考系重定向流水线，把相机中心和物体中心坐标系歧义显式消解。作者还探索了在兼容性数据上的微调及其与提示策略的相互作用。
summary.experiments: 在 RoboSpatial Challenge / RoboSpatial-Home 上评估，报告总体成功率 80.9%，获得挑战赛第一。摘要未给出更多基线细节、数据规模或统计显著性，因此更像经验性系统组合而非干净方法学结论。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets embodied spatial reasoning failures in VLMs, especially reference-frame ambiguity and when to trigger explicit reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a challenge technical report rather than a new pretraining method. Its value lies in two practical inference-time tricks: selective reasoning activation and explicit reference-frame redirection. Useful as a systems note for multimodal reasoning, but only loosely relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV, the system adds two training-free inference mechanisms: a forced <think> prefix plus task-specific post-prompt to elicit deliberate reasoning, and a reference-frame redirection pipeline to resolve camera-centric versus object-centric ambiguity. The authors also explore fine-tuning on compatibility data and its interaction with prompting.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on RoboSpatial Challenge / RoboSpatial-Home, it reports 80.9% overall success and first place in the challenge. The abstract does not provide much detail on baselines, data scale, or statistical rigor, so this reads more like a strong system recipe than a clean methodological result.

recommendation.zh: 比赛解法，方法新意一般；只看参考系消歧和 <think> 触发是否真带来稳定增益，别把榜单名次当成可迁移结论。
recommendation.en: A challenge solution with modest novelty; only inspect whether reference-frame disambiguation and forced <think> actually yield stable gains, and do not overread the leaderboard result.

paper.title: On the Stability of Prompt Ranking in Large Language Model Evaluation
paper.abstract: Prompt-based interaction has become a dominant paradigm for using large language models (LLMs), where multiple candidate prompts are evaluated and the top-ranked one is selected for downstream use. This workflow implicitly assumes that prompt rankings are stable under minor variations in evaluation conditions. In this paper, we systematically study prompt ranking stability under common sources of variability, including random seeds and limited evaluation subsets. Across three open-weight LLMs an

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM prompt 评测中一个常被默认成立的前提：在随机种子或评测子集轻微变化下，prompt 排名是否稳定。
summary.importance: 这是评测方法工作。它的重要性不在提出新 prompt，而在指出 prompt selection pipeline 本身可能不稳，尤其是 top-1 prompt 的身份会频繁变化。对预训练研究员的价值主要是实验设计层面：很多 prompt-based ablation 的结论可能比表面看起来更脆弱。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统考察两类常见扰动：随机种子变化，以及只用有限评测子集做 prompt 排名。虽然整体 rank correlation 往往中高，但 top prompt 的具体身份不稳定。为此提出一个简单的 stability-aware 选择策略，用 lower confidence bound 同时考虑平均性能和方差，而不是只按均值排序。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个开源模型和 2 个 benchmark 任务。主要发现是：整体相关性看起来不差，但真正用于部署时最关键的 top prompt 经常换人，导致选择不可靠。所提 lower-confidence-bound 策略在不稳定设置下更稳健，在稳定设置下也保持竞争力。摘要未给出具体模型名和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether prompt rankings in LLM evaluation remain stable under small changes such as random seeds or limited evaluation subsets.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-method paper. Its value is not in proposing a new prompt, but in showing that the prompt-selection pipeline itself can be unstable, especially when the identity of the top prompt changes. For pretraining researchers, the main takeaway is experimental hygiene: many prompt-based ablations may be less reliable than they appear.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors systematically vary two common sources of noise: random seeds and limited evaluation subsets. They find that overall rank correlations can look moderately high while the actual top-ranked prompt changes frequently. To mitigate this, they propose a simple stability-aware selection rule based on a lower confidence bound that accounts for both mean performance and variance.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses three open-weight LLMs and two benchmark tasks. The main result is that top-prompt identity is often unstable even when aggregate rank correlation seems acceptable, making selection decisions unreliable. The lower-confidence-bound strategy improves robustness in unstable settings while remaining competitive in stable ones. The abstract does not provide exact model names or gains.

recommendation.zh: 这是实验卫生论文，不会改你的模型设计，但会改你看 prompt ablation 的方式；只看“rank correlation 高但 top-1 不稳”这个结论和 LCB 选择法就够了。
recommendation.en: This is an experimental-hygiene paper, not a model-design paper; the useful bit is that high rank correlation can still hide unstable top-1 prompt selection, plus the simple LCB fix.

paper.title: Cross-Lingual Exploration for Parametric Knowledge
paper.abstract: Parametric knowledge in Large Language Models is not equally accessible across languages. As a result, standard inference techniques often struggle to surface localized facts, leading to failures in cross-lingual knowledge transfer and consistency. In this work, we investigate techniques for accessing hidden factual knowledge by exploring cross-lingual prompting strategies. We identify four inherent dimensions of cross-lingual exploration that directly govern parametric knowledge retrieval and e

summary.core_problem: 多语言 LLM 的“参数化知识”在不同语言上的可达性不均：同一个事实，模型可能在英语问答时答不出或幻觉，但换成某个本地语言（脚本/文化语境更贴近）就能被“唤出”。论文要解决的是：在不改模型参数的前提下，如何用跨语言的推理/提示探索，更稳定地检索到模型已存但难以访问的事实，并提升跨语言知识迁移与一致性。
summary.importance:
对预训练的直接改动不多，但它把一个常被忽略的问题讲清楚：多语预训练并不等价于多语可用，知识“存储”与“可访问”之间有推理时的鸿沟。对基座研究的启发主要有三点：
1）评测视角：跨语言一致性不应只看平均准确率，语言路径会改变可达知识的分布。
2）训练视角：如果推理时需要靠语言路由才能取回知识，说明预训练阶段的对齐/共享表示可能不足；可考虑在 mid-train 加入跨语言等价问答、对比学习或多语言 self-consistency 风格的训练信号。
3）系统视角：在预算受限下，跨语言探索提供了一个“用少量额外 compute 换更高 factual recall”的推理策略基线，可作为检索增强之外的另一条路。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是推理时的 cross-lingual exploration 设计空间分解与策略评测，而非提出单一固定算法。核心思想：把“用哪种语言/脚本来思考与作答”当作探索维度，生成多条语言路径（例如把问题翻译到若干候选语言，在各语言中独立推理/检索参数知识，再把答案汇总到目标语言）。
论文声称识别了4个内在维度来刻画跨语言探索（全文细节在后续章节展开；从引言与图示可见至少包含：推理语言与作答语言是否一致、是否使用单一 pivot 语言、是否多路径采样与聚合、以及提示中哪些组件被翻译/保留）。它强调两点区分：
1）不是默认英语 pivot：某些“本地化事实”在对应语言更容易被激活。
2）收益不只是因为多采样带来更多 compute：作者尝试把语言选择带来的增益与纯粹增加采样/token 的增益区分开。
聚合方式上，类似 cross-lingual self-consistency：多语言路径各自产生候选答案，再做选择/投票/一致性聚合，以提高命中正确事实的概率并降低幻觉。
summary.experiments:
评测覆盖17种类型学差异较大的语言；任务是多语言事实性基准上的 knowledge transfer / factual recall / consistency。
从文中图2可读到的定性结论：在多种模型上（示例包含 Gemini 2.5 Flash、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o、GPT-4o mini、Qwen3 235B、Grok 4.1 Fast），跨语言探索策略相对 baseline 有一致提升；不同策略实现之间存在差异，说明“怎么翻译、翻到哪种语言、是否多路径聚合”会显著影响收益。
当前给出的片段未包含完整表格数字与显著性检验细节；但作者明确主张：跨语言探索在 compute–performance 上形成更好的 Pareto 前沿，并且能提升跨语言一致性，且一致性提升不完全由准确率提升解释。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45分钟）：
1）先看 Figure 1：理解它要解决的失败模式——英语路径幻觉、日语路径命中、再多语言聚合更稳。
2）看方法章节对“四个维度”的定义与策略表（文中提到 table 1 / strategy implementations）：这是可复现实现的关键。
3）看实验部分对“不是纯 compute 增益”的对照：它决定这篇工作是否只是多采样的变体。
4）看一致性指标的定义与分析：很多工作只报准确率，这篇的卖点之一是把 consistency 单独拉出来。
如果时间更少：只读方法维度 + 主要结果图/表即可，预计20分钟能抓住要点。

summary_en.core_problem: Parametric knowledge in multilingual LLMs is unevenly accessible across languages: a model may fail or hallucinate in English while the same fact becomes retrievable when prompted/reasoned in a more “localized” language/script. The paper studies how to recover such hidden factual knowledge at inference time via cross-lingual prompting/exploration, improving cross-lingual knowledge transfer and consistency without changing model weights.
summary_en.importance:
Not a pretraining recipe, but it clarifies a practical and conceptual gap: multilingual pretraining does not guarantee multilingual accessibility. For foundation-model work, it matters in three ways:
1) Evaluation: language choice changes the reachable region of parametric knowledge; cross-lingual consistency deserves explicit measurement beyond average accuracy.
2) Training implications: if inference-time language routing is needed to unlock facts, representation sharing/alignment during pretraining may be insufficient; this motivates mid-training signals such as cross-lingual equivalence QA, contrastive alignment, or training-time self-consistency across languages.
3) Inference/system baseline: cross-lingual exploration is a compute-efficient alternative (or complement) to retrieval augmentation for factual recall, especially under budget constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is a structured design space for inference-time cross-lingual exploration rather than a single new algorithm. The core move is to treat “reasoning language / answering language” as exploration axes: translate the query into one or multiple candidate languages, run independent reasoning paths in each language to elicit parametric facts, then aggregate candidates back into the target language.
They claim four inherent dimensions governing cross-lingual exploration (details are in the main method section; from the provided content and cited prior work, these dimensions plausibly include: reasoning vs answering language, pivot vs non-pivot routing, which prompt components are translated, and multi-path sampling/aggregation).
A key stance is to move beyond an English-only pivot: some culturally/localized facts are more accessible in their native language. Aggregation resembles cross-lingual self-consistency: multiple linguistic paths produce candidates, and a selection/voting mechanism increases the probability of retrieving the correct entity while reducing hallucinations.
summary_en.experiments:
They evaluate on multilingual factual benchmarks spanning 17 typologically diverse languages, reporting knowledge transfer, factual recall, and cross-lingual consistency.
From the shown Figure 2: across several models (Gemini 2.5/2.0 Flash, GPT-4o/mini, Qwen3 235B, Grok 4.1 Fast), cross-lingual exploration strategies consistently outperform baselines, and different strategy implementations yield different gains—suggesting that language choice and translation/aggregation details matter.
The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables; the paper’s stated claim is that improvements are not merely due to extra compute and that cross-lingual consistency improves beyond what accuracy alone explains.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Figure 1 to internalize the failure mode and why multi-language paths help.
2) The method section defining the four dimensions and the strategy table (implementation-level details).
3) The ablations that separate “language exploration” gains from “more sampling/compute” gains.
4) The consistency metric definition and analysis—this is one of the differentiators.
If you only have ~20 minutes: read the dimension definitions + the main result figure/table.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改一点 prior：多语问题不只是数据缺口，也有知识可达性问题；先看四个探索维度和 Pareto 结论。
recommendation.en: This slightly shifts the prior: multilingual failure is not just a data deficit but also an accessibility problem; read the four exploration dimensions and the Pareto result.

paper.title: Large Language Models Do Not Always Need Readable Language
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are commonly prompted and interfaced with human-readable natural language, even when the intended reader is another model. This paper investigates whether semantic information can be encoded in compact, non-standard textual forms that sacrifice human readability while remaining recoverable by LLMs. We refer to this class of model-centric textual representations as BabelTele, approached here not as a fixed protocol but as an empirical probe into LLMs' capacity to gene

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM 在与其他模型通信时，是否必须使用人类可读的自然语言，还是可以使用更短、更稠密但不可读的文本表示来传递语义。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是表示能力分析和模型间通信探针。它把“语言是否需要可读”这个默认假设拆开，考察 instruction-tuned LLM 对非标准文本编码的生成、理解和语义恢复能力。对 tokenizer、latent language、模型间通信协议有一定参考价值，但还不是预训练范式或系统性训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BabelTele 作为一类模型中心文本表示，不把它定义成固定编码协议，而是作为经验探针。论文通过可读性诊断、模型似然、人类问卷和下游任务评估，比较普通自然语言与非标准压缩文本在语义保持、长度压缩和模型可恢复性上的差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 BabelTele 可以把文本体积压缩到原始长度的 27.9%，同时保持 99.5% 的语义保真度。实验覆盖 readability diagnostics、likelihood measures、human questionnaires 和 downstream task evaluations，但摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集规模和完整 baseline 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM-to-LLM communication must use human-readable natural language, or whether compact, non-standard textual forms can preserve semantics for models.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a representational probe rather than a pretraining method. It challenges the default interface assumption that meaningful prompts should be human-readable, which makes it relevant to tokenizer design, latent language, and model-centric communication, though the current setup remains prompt-level.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce BabelTele as a family of model-centric textual representations, not as a fixed protocol. They evaluate it with readability diagnostics, model likelihood, human questionnaires, and downstream task performance to test whether instruction-tuned LLMs can generate and interpret compressed non-standard strings.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 99.5% semantic fidelity while reducing text volume to 27.9% of the original. The study uses readability, likelihood, human, and downstream evaluations, but the abstract does not specify model sizes, training data, or full baseline details.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 latent language 方向的弱信号；只看实验设置和压缩-保真曲线，别把它当 tokenizer 结论。
recommendation.en: A weak signal for latent-language work; read the setup and compression–fidelity curve, but do not treat it as evidence about tokenizer design yet.

paper.title: Exploring Extrinsic and Intrinsic Properties for Effective Reasoning with Code Interpreter
paper.abstract: Reasoning with a Code Interpreter (CI) has emerged as an effective paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) through executable computation and iterative verification. Despite its growing adoption, the behavioral properties underlying effective code reasoning remain largely underexplored. In this work, we investigate code reasoning from two distinct perspectives inspired by prior studies of natural language reasoning: extrinsic properties, represented by c

summary.core_problem: 解释“带 Code Interpreter 的推理”为什么更强，并把可观测的行为特征转化为可用的推理增强信号。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是行为分析+轻量提示/训练信号设计；对预训练本身不直接，但对“可执行验证/回溯”这类推理范式的训练信号有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 把有效CI推理分解为两类属性：外在的“crucial tokens”（关键触发词/标记）与内在的代码推理行为（verification、backtracking、backward chaining等）；在推理时追加关键token做引导，并探索在训练阶段利用这些属性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型列表、数据集与提升幅度；仅声称跨多个LLM观察到强模型更频繁出现关键token与上述行为，并在推理时追加token可提升表现。

summary_en.core_problem: Understand why Code-Interpreter-assisted reasoning works and turn observable behavioral properties into usable signals for better reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Behavioral analysis plus lightweight prompting/training signals; not pretraining-centric, but relevant to training signals for executable verification and backtracking-style reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decompose effective CI reasoning into extrinsic 'crucial tokens' and intrinsic code-reasoning behaviors (verification, backtracking, backward chaining); use crucial tokens at inference and explore leveraging these properties during training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits concrete model/dataset lists and effect sizes; it claims consistent correlations across multiple LLMs and gains from appending crucial tokens.

recommendation.zh: 当弱信号看：只需扫结论里“哪些行为与强CI相关”，但缺少干净因果与完整实验细节，别据此改训练配方。
recommendation.en: Treat as a weak signal: skim the behavior correlates of strong CI reasoning, but don’t change recipes without cleaner causality and full experimental details.
